label: Volume value-area high
gloss: the upper edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — the same expansion rule as tpoVAH, over the volume tally — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low

label: Trades

label: Trading session
gloss: the trading session the bar opened in, fixed in UTC with no daylight-saving rule: asia (Asia 00–08 UTC), london (London 08–13 UTC), newYork (New York 13–21 UTC), late (Late 21–24 UTC) — a fact of the bar's open time

label: UTC hour
gloss: the hour of the UTC day the bar opened in, 0 to 23 — a fact of the bar's open time, never of when it is read

label: Volume
